# laravelforge_firewall_rule (Resource)

Manages a firewall rule on a Laravel Forge server. Firewall rules cannot be updated in place; any change forces a replacement.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the firewall rule.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server to create the firewall rule on.
- `type` (String) Rule type (`allow` or `deny`).

### Optional

- `ip_address` (String) IP address or subnet the rule applies to.
- `port` (String) Port or port range for the firewall rule.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the firewall rule.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status of the rule.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.
